name: Lydari Druid — each land becomes the basic land type rolled for it
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). "When this creature enters, for each land on the battlefield, choose a basic land type at random. Those lands become the land types chosen this way." produced nothing, and the card itself asked for a land type. Firing the trigger now rolls a type for each land on the battlefield and rewrites the effect to one line a land ("Target land becomes a Swamp."), each line a target slot holding its land; a saved board replays the rolled text. queueRandomPicks fixes the rolls here: Forest → Swamp, Island → Mountain, Savannah → Island. Each land has only its new land type (Savannah loses Forest and Plains) and that type's mana ability; Grizzly Bears is untouched.
